title: AmongZin
description: This is a werewolf game designed for 10 to 20 players.
body:
This datapack turns Minecraft into a Werewolf game!
AmongZin is a custom Minecraft 1.21.1 datapack that turns your world into a thrilling social deduction game. Players are randomly assigned unique roles across three factions: Village, Wolves, and Third Party. Survive, strategize, and use your abilities to outwit opponents. Includes role-specific powers, kill-based and objective-based victory conditions, and a dynamic start-game system for multiplayer intrigue and deception!
Features:

- 10 unique roles with custom abilities:
  * Wolf: eliminate all non-Wolf players
  * Madman: secretly a Wolf ally but appears as Villager to investigations
  * Chef: distributes bread periodically while alive
  * Hunter: gains health boosts
  * Twins: know each other; if one dies, the other dies
  * Serial Killer: Third Party; wins by eliminating all others
  * Dark Seer: notified when players die; appears as Villager to others but has hidden info
  * Watcher: receives death notifications when any player dies
  *Seer: You start with a Seer's eye (a divination item) and periodically acquire a Seer's eye.
  * Villager: standard Village role

- Three factions:
  * Village: wins by eliminating Wolves and Third Party, or delivering 20 Diamonds to the Barrel
  * Wolves: wins by eliminating all Village players
  * Third Party: wins by eliminating all other players

- Victory types:
  * Kill-based: eliminate all opposing factions
  * Objective-based: e.g., deliver 20 Diamonds to the Barrel

- Fully automated start-game countdown and role assignment
- Bossbar tracking and in-game scoreboards for objectives
- Messages and hover-text explanations for each role in English
- Customizable role counts via triggers

AmongZin is perfect for multiplayer sessions with friends who enjoy deception, strategy, and hidden roles.
